description: Reads text aloud and returns a link to the MP3 (kept 30 days). voice is a free-text direction, e.g. "a warm, amused British narrator"; a [bracketed] cue before a sentence sets its emotion, e.g. "[whispering] It's here.". To clone a voice, give reference_audio_url (MP3 or WAV, 10–30 s of clean speech) and, ideally, reference_text. Billed per character read (the direction too); see list_models. The same request again within 10 minutes returns the same recording, not a second charge.

model.description: A speech model from list_models (kind audio); the first one when left out.

reference_audio_url.description: A recording to clone the voice from: public https link or an upload_media link.

reference_text.description: What is said in that recording.

run_again.description: Make another take even if the same request was just made.

text.description: What to say. May contain [bracketed] emotion cues.

voice.description: How it sounds: a free-text voice direction.

name: speak

status.description: succeeded, or running: then call speak again with the same arguments (the same call, no new charge).

title: Speak
